purpose: Numerical method exercise using real environmental data and entirely hypothetical farm/calendar inputs.
climate_context_role: Explicit regional example context, not a meteorological measurement at the crop pixel.
assumptions: Existing padi-padi is a hypothetical continuation for this fixture, not an observed farmer history.
The first crop is held fixed for comparison, not a verified crop currently growing.
Both planting starts, all three elapsed-day durations, direct seeding and 14-day preparation gap are synthetic assumptions.
The 90-day soybean duration does not resolve the ambiguous duration origin in the Anjasmoro cultivar reference or select that cultivar.
Environmental inputs remain unchanged real data; this replay is not a forecast for a future season.
